description: CI lanes for .github/workflows/package-validation.yaml. 'branches' maps the target branch (PR base, or the pushed/dispatched branch) to a lane; a branch that is not listed fails the job. Each lane gives the R series ('X.Y' or 'devel'), the Bioconductor version, and a dependency-cache namespace that must contain 'bioc-<bioc_version>' and be unique across lanes. Change a lane here, never the job name.
